title: Bisect
statement: Implement `solve(nums, target)`. `nums` is sorted ascending and may contain duplicates. Return the leftmost index at which `target` could be inserted without breaking the order. That index is also the first index of `target` if it is present. If `target` is greater than every element, return `len(nums)`.
constraints: The insertion index may equal the length
hints: Keep a half-open window lo, hi.
When nums[mid] < target, the insertion point is to the right of mid.
Otherwise it is at mid or to the left. End with lo.
editorial: bisect_left is the lower bound. Moving left on every equal element is what makes the index the first match rather than an arbitrary match. The window is empty when lo == hi, and lo is the answer, including the end of the list.
